About Skyboom

Building Ghana's telecom backbone since 2017

Skyboom Ghana Limited is a 100% Ghanaian-owned telecom services provider based in Accra — combining local knowledge with international engineering standards to build infrastructure that lasts.

Our story

A Ghanaian company built on engineering integrity

Established in 2017 and headquartered in Tse-Addo, Accra, Skyboom Ghana Limited was founded to raise the standard of telecom infrastructure delivery in Ghana. As a wholly Ghanaian-owned business, we understand the local ground, climate, grid and regulatory landscape in a way that matters on every project.

Over the years we've grown into a full-service telecom infrastructure partner — deploying networks, installing equipment from the world's leading manufacturers, laying and splicing fibre, building FTTH access networks, aligning microwave links, delivering civil works and designing resilient data centres across Ghana and West Africa.

What ties it together is a simple commitment: quality, safety and efficiency on every build. Backed by the financial stability to partner-finance projects, we help clients move on critical infrastructure with confidence.

Health & Safety commitment

Safety is the foundation of quality

We believe that how you build determines how well it works — and how safely it's built determines everything. Skyboom embeds Health & Safety into planning, execution and maintenance, protecting our teams and delivering infrastructure our clients can trust.

  • Manufacturer Experience Hands-on experience with leading global telecom equipment manufacturers means fewer integration surprises and installations that protect your OEM warranties.
  • Financial Stability The financial capacity to partner-finance projects lets clients move on infrastructure now and structure payment around delivery milestones.
  • Health & Safety First A strong, embedded Health & Safety culture protects our crews, your assets and the communities we build in — on every site, every day.
  • 100% Ghanaian-Owned Established in 2017 and wholly Ghanaian-owned, we combine local knowledge of Ghana and West Africa with international engineering standards.
